description: Liwaza Foundation is the team for Liwaza students in grades 8 and 9. On 14–15 November 2026 we will build a simple game or app that lets younger students run a Moon or Mars outpost. Players will have to balance life support, radiation shielding, power, and food, and see how each choice helps the mission succeed or fail. Join this team only if you are in the Liwaza Foundation group.
